ThingDef.label: F-rank gate summoning scroll
ThingDef.description:
A paper scroll inked with a turning gate. Read aloud, it tears a F-rank dungeon gate open right beside the reader.
Barely a tremor on the page. Whatever answers will be something a handful of armed colonists can put down.
A summoned gate behaves like any other: clear its boss and it closes, or leave it and it breaks when its clock runs out. It cannot be read inside a dungeon.
